edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Sylas is melee and must walk into Death's Hand range to farm — poke every last-hit; your real spells arrive next.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: E online: the root that defines the lane. He is still short-range fodder — root his step-up and the Q follow-up chunks him.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two items in, his E mobility, Kingslayer healing and stolen ults edge ahead — fight grouped where your AoE R beats his slip.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond/Abduct (E): 13s at rank 1, 9s max — his only way in; punish hard while it is down. - Kingslayer (W) heal: 12s early — trade when it is spent. - Your Nevermove is 12s; his stolen Hijack runs 80/55/30s, track it like a second ult.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of the Empire reaches 5500+ units — drop it on river and jungle entrances when he shoves and vanishes; the reveal turns his roam into a ping.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: His E resets off your wave — chasing hands him free Kingslayer healing and a re-engage angle your walking speed cannot match.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Hijacking your Demonic Ascension, dashing in while Nevermove is down, and Kingslayer-healing through trades you thought you won.
